bt.summary: Build every Release target and run six smoke tests sequentially

history.reason: routine ask (create): Create a routine that builds every Release target and then runs exactly these six smoke tests, in this order: llm_stream_smoke, headless_smoke, triage_smoke, bt_ipc_smoke, bt_integration_smoke, taskqueue_smoke. Build step command: cmake --build build --config Release (do NOT add --target, because the smoke-test executables must be built too); timeoutSec 3600. Then run each smoke as its own separate exec job, command build\Release\<name>.exe, cwd D:/wsgit/Hancho, timeoutSec 900, in the order listed above. Do not use foreach or glob; list the six tests explicitly. Give every node an English summary. Use type exec for jobs. The build node must succeed before any smoke runs.

history.userSaid: 全ターゲット（Hancho, hancho-cli, HanchoChat, HanchoTerm, wct）のビルドおよび全スモークテスト（llm_stream_smoke, headless_smoke, triage_smoke, bt_ipc_smoke, bt_integration_smoke, taskqueue_smoke）を実行しています。 を Hanchoのルーチンにして登録してくれ。
